Pam Bondi skipped showing up for her hearing and she continues to avoid our committee. 

Unfortunately for her, she has no choice but to negotiate coming in — or she’ll be held in contempt. We want answers from her, and we’re not stopping until we get them.

Video

Donald Trump promised $1,000 more on your tax return. That didn't happen.

Instead, prices are skyrocketing for everyday Americans while the rich are getting richer. This President is betraying the people he's supposed to represent.

There's a lot the First Lady can do to help our Epstein case.

She could demand that her husband release the full files.
She could ensure Pam Bondi testifies before Congress.
She could tell Todd Blanche that this investigation is not "over," like he says it is.

And she should.

Video

There has been no indication that Pam Bondi is actually going to comply with our subpoena, which legally requires her to testify before the Committee.

In that case, we have no other choice but to move forward with contempt charges.

Video

Pam Bondi didn’t show up for her hearing today, despite our subpoena. We’re going to begin contempt proceedings. It’s time to hold these people accountable to the laws we passed in Congress.

Video

Todd Blanche needs a reminder that there’s a legally binding subpoena for documents that is different than the law. 

This investigation is not a hoax. The DOJ needs to release the rest of files.


Aaron Rupar (@atrupar)

FOX NEWS: You have the authority to go ahead and release more Epstein files, do you not?

ACTING AG TODD BLANCHE: No. We have released everything. We are not sitting on a single piece of paper. If we didn't release it, it's because it was not responsive to the law.

Video

Today marks the start of Cambodian New Year.

Long Beach has the largest population of Cambodians in the U.S. To all who celebrate, may this be a time for gratitude and renewal.

Our bipartisan subpoena was very clear: Pam Bondi is supposed to testify tomorrow, whether she's the AG or not.

If she doesn't show up, she will face contempt.

Video

If Melania Trump actually wants to help in our Epstein investigation, she should demand that her husband release the rest of the files and ensure Pam Bondi testifies.

Survivors deserve justice.

We are at war with Iran with no clear mission while gas prices skyrocket.

We need to end this war immediately.

Video

If Melania Trump wants real justice, she should ask her husband to release the rest of the Epstein files and ensure that Pam Bondi testifies.

No more distractions.

Video

No one, and certainly not the White House, is going to distract us from our Epstein investigation.

Pam Bondi must testify. It’s time to end this cover-up.
